report:
Oral cavity, left lateral tongue, biopsy

Sections show a well-differentiated invasive squamous cell carcinoma, composed of infiltrating nests and cords of atypical squamous cells with abundant keratinisation, keratin pearls and intercellular bridges, and mild nuclear pleomorphism, within a desmoplastic stroma. Perineural invasion is present. The biopsy is superficial and the depth of invasion cannot be assessed.

ORAL CAVITY, left lateral tongue, biopsy - WELL-DIFFERENTIATED SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA
